name: Sonoike Sakurako
source:
A childhood friend who has been close to the protagonist since kindergarten and knows him well. She honestly tells the protagonist what she wants and never forgets to stand up for him.
Currently, her relationship with the protagonist is as follows: "There is love, but no romantic feelings. There are no romantic feelings, but there is love," and no progress has been made.
